lines.text: Did you know? Dict is Latin for say.
Quick quiz! Which means before plus say?

words.ex: The new evidence contradicts earlier findings.
The results indicate that the plan is working.
Our sales prediction for next year is optimistic.

publish.title: Dict root: contradict, indicate and prediction
publish.value: Dict comes from Latin "dicere" (to say). Words: contradict, indicate and prediction. contradict = contra + dict; indicate = in + dic; prediction = pre + dict.
